patch_description: This redesign replaces the monolithic moving-window loop with a stateful streaming pipeline. The enhanced path uses a causal robust measurement stage, adaptive constant-velocity Kalman tracking, innovation clipping, and velocity hysteresis. This structure separates noise estimation, outlier handling, prediction, correction, and trend-direction stabilization. It preserves endpoint-aligned output length while reducing noise-driven reversals without introducing moving-average phase delay. The basic algorithm is also vectorized with cumulative sums for efficient sliding-window averaging.
